compute.cost_note: one sentence-transformers encoder pass over all windows; model downloads on first use; CPU works, GPU faster

do_not_use_when: you need the --baseline prior-run comparison; it reads a top-level trajectory key that the saved JSON envelope nests under results, so it comes back empty
you want sentence-level cohesion for smoothing diagnosis (variance_audit tier 3 covers that)

examples.description: Paragraph-level semantic trajectory with a Markdown report

purpose: Semantic trajectory of a draft. Embeds paragraph, sentence or fixed-token windows with a sentence-transformers model and reports the trajectory of adjacent cosine similarities (tightness, burstiness, first-to-last drift and slope).
use_when: asking how the thread of meaning moves across a draft at paragraph scale
